//: Souvenir boards (docs/souvenirs.md, approved by the creator 2026-10-28): 12 long pictures a trip, each generated one on its own bold colour (bg, never two alike in a Souvenir), museum works as themselves (CC0, credited). tools/art/souvenirs.py builds them; tools/art/pictures.py writes them to the catalogue's souvenirPictures and souvenirs.

t1.prefix: A glossy 3D render, like a still from a polished animated film, with soft studio light:
t1.on: on a plain, flat, bold {word} background ({hex})

t3.prefix: A museum photograph of an ancient Roman piece in marble or bronze, softly lit like a museum catalogue shot, a generic piece and not a copy of any famous statue, any figure clothed or draped:
t3.on: standing in front of a plain, seamless, bold {word} studio backdrop ({hex})

t4.prefix: A linocut print: bold carved black lines, the subject filled with flat cream and warm tan inks, the slightly uneven texture of a hand-pulled print:
t4.on: printed on a plain, flat, bold {word} ground ({hex})

t6.prefix: A layered papercut illustration in matte coloured paper, with soft shadows between the paper layers:
t6.on: on a plain, flat, bold {word} paper background ({hex})

t7.prefix: A painting in the Buenos Aires fileteado style: bright saturated colours, crisp black outlines, glossy shading, curling acanthus scrolls and flourishes framing the subject, no lettering:
t7.on: on a plain, flat, bold {word} background ({hex})

t8.prefix: A hand-coloured 19th-century natural-history lithograph, like a plate from a zoology book, with fine engraved lines and soft watercolour tints:
t8.on: on a plain, flat, bold {word} background ({hex}), not paper

t9.prefix: A professional studio food photograph, crisp and appetising, with soft light:
t9.on: on a plain, seamless, bold {word} backdrop ({hex})

t10.prefix: Toy photography: a die-cast metal toy model with glossy painted metal, photographed close with a shallow depth of field:
t10.on: on a plain, seamless, bold {word} backdrop ({hex})

suffix: The subject is large, centred and whole, filling most of the frame along its length, so each half of the picture shows a different, recognisable part of it. The background is one plain, flat colour from edge to edge: no texture, pattern, scenery, floor, props, shadow or vignette. Nothing written anywhere: no text, letters, numbers, logos, brand names, labels, signature, watermark, border or frame.
tableLook: Match exactly the look of the references: the same soft painterly-realistic rendering, the same lighting mood of a warm light low from above against cool shadow, deep focus, the same camera seen from above at the same slight angle, and exactly the same layout as the reference table: detail only along the left, right and bottom edges and in the two top corners, where a warm light source sits partly cut by the frame; the whole middle, from just below the top corners to just above the bottom edge and across most of the width, is a calm, smooth, DARKER, completely empty surface with only a very faint texture and a soft vignette, darker than the edges, because bright picture cards will sit there.
tableEnd: Draw ONLY the empty table as a portrait background for a mobile game, portrait 9:16. No cards, no card stacks, no buttons, no bar, no UI, no text, no people.

souvenirs.tablePrompt: The new setting: a 1950s AMERICAN DINER COUNTER at dusk. The table is a speckled teal-grey Formica counter top with a slim chrome edge. In the top-left and top-right corners, warm glowing pendant lamps with amber glass shades, partly cut by the frame, casting soft pools of warm light onto the counter below them. Along the edges: a chrome napkin dispenser and a glass sugar pourer at the left, a small chrome jukebox selector box at the right, red and yellow squeeze bottles with no labels, a striped paper straw, and a coffee cup on a saucer at the bottom edge partly cut. The middle is calm, deep dark teal-grey Formica, darker than the lit edges, empty.
souvenirs.backPrompt: The SAME single card back as the first reference, with exactly the same look: the same portrait 3:4 shape filling the frame edge to edge, the same generously rounded chubby corners with the same corner radius, the same plump soft rendering, the same thin pale highlight along its top and left rim and slightly darker rim along the bottom and right, and the same one small round glowing warm amber dot (#e99645) exactly in the centre, perfectly round and the same size. Only change its face: a cherry-red (#8a2a30) glossy diner-booth vinyl with a very fine texture, like the booth seats of an old diner, with no pattern. Seen perfectly straight on from directly above, centred. No stack, no other cards, no shadow, no table, no text. Isolated on a transparent background.
